evidence.summary: Per-request log line now records the branch taken: tenant_scope bound tenant=<t> product_lines=<all|assigned:n|unset> (was set/unset). No user id or line names logged. Live API restart observed through cip-supervisor-status.ps1 (starting -> healthy, /health 200).

rationale: An operator can tell from the API log whether a request ran as admin-all, assigned (with count) or unset. Limitation: no metric or alert on scope decisions; not required at R2.
